description:
RideArrivo is airport pickup and private car hire, built for Lagos.

Book your car before you land. Add your flight number and we track the flight for you, so a delayed landing moves your pickup time automatically and your driver is already waiting when you clear arrivals.

WHAT YOU CAN BOOK

Airport pickup, timed to when you actually land
Airport drop off, scheduled around your departure
A ride anywhere in the city
A chauffeur for a full day, or for several days
On the Go, for when you need a car within the next few hours

CHOOSE THE CAR

Pick a saloon or an SUV, and add a Premium Trim Upgrade for a higher spec version of the same vehicle. Travelling as a group or carrying luggage? RideArrivo suggests what will fit, and you can add extra vehicles to travel alongside you.

TRAVELLING SAFELY

Every driver is checked before they carry a passenger, including licence, LASDRI and insurance documents. Follow your car on a live map, message your driver in the app, and save an emergency contact we can reach if we cannot reach you. A personal security escort can be added to any booking.

CLEAR PRICING

See the full fare before you confirm. Every extra shows what it costs, so there are no surprises at the end of the trip. Pay by card, from your RideArrivo wallet, or with a membership.

RideArrivo is operated by RICHATHAOIR LIMITED, registered in Nigeria under CAC RC 1654710.

Need a hand? Email info@ridearrivo.com or reach us on WhatsApp from inside the app.
promotionalText: Add your flight number and we track it. Land late and your pickup moves with you. Airport transfers, city rides and chauffeur hire across Lagos.
